titulo: Pentagon’s Hegseth says 20 percent of US generals, admirals cut, ‘no fatties, no trannies’
cuerpo: US Defence Secretary Pete Hegseth said Wednesday that his department had cut 20 percent of US admirals, generals and officers who did not fit his vision. "Simple translation of that: no fatties, no trannies, no beardos, no weirdos, no wimps, no radicals. Just warriors – just tough, ready, committed troops," he said.
